items.title: Simon Willison used Claude Code to build a 'beep locator' that triangulates a mystery sound with spare devices
items.summary_en: Independent developer Simon Willison describes how he had a coding agent build a small Python server that turns spare phones, tablets and laptops into microphone listeners. The devices work together to triangulate an intermittent beep in a room full of boxes. Secondary summaries say the source turned out to be an old carbon monoxide detector with a dead battery, located to within about 40 cm; this was not verified against the full post.
